core_meaning.primary_meaning: Lal corresponds to the Arabic form لعل and is glossed in this record as “Ruby, garnet.” The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Lal corresponds to the Arabic form لعل (Arabic لَعْل (Laʿl)). Its core sense is ruby, garnet; (also) a red gem. Lal is Arabic لَعْل (Laʿl) 'ruby, garnet'. The source gloss 'Night' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as laal.

persian.name: لعل
persian.long_meaning: Lal (لعل) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن لعل، یاقوت سرخ است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: लाल
